race.comment: NATIONAL ASSET (4) wasn't beaten far in a good race at Goulburn last time out and looks well placed in this event off the back of that effort. Back to this level and distance range looks a good move off a freshen and the 2kg claim comes in handy. Can bounce back to winning ways in this suitable event. FEEDBACK (10) was solid from the front here two back before a disappoitning effort in a BM55 at Canberra most recently. Should be able to lead again like he did here two back and that may hold the key to seeing him return to winning ways. JUST ONE LOOK (11) won nicely two back before a solid effort last time out at Tamworth. Won't be far away if he can bring his best form. DIAMOND FROST (3) gets Loy on board today back out in trip and can make his presence felt.
